title: Traditional Greek Kleftiko
description: A classic Greek lamb dish slow-cooked in the oven, perfect for a special occasion. The long cooking time infuses the meat with flavor and tenderness.
instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the lamb with salt, black pepper, and rosemary.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and caramelized, about 20-25 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Return the lamb to the pot and add the potatoes around it.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 4-5 hours, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
